fusions.name: Grit Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 4 chips of grit at once, spread apart; each deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 18 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Cloud Over the Yard
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm for 10 seconds. Every second it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage.

fusions.name: Rubble-Fed
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
